title: The Creative Act: A Way of Being
author: Rick Rubin
summary: Music producer Rick Rubin offers short, reflective chapters on making art, treating creativity as a way of living and paying attention rather than a set of techniques.
readIf: you want calm, aphoristic encouragement to make things and trust your instincts.
skipIf: you want concrete exercises or step-by-step methods for finishing a project.
